correctness.rationale: Binary quadratic polar alternating rank yields minimum Hamming weight n/4 on codimension-two affine flats and next possible Hamming weight >=3n/8. The first essential bit j of an affine-flat indicator forces at least n/2^(j+3) cyclic one-runs; with weight n/4 this yields T_j threshold. Adjacent eight top-bit block-pair indicators give 7-dimensional RM(2,3); explicit (x_j+x_{j+1})(x_i+b) and three-equal-bit indicator add independent quotient monomials at each lower-bit threshold. Cayley components are cosets of H_alpha. Independent full direct enumeration at m=3,4,5 (127+2047+65535=67709 nonzero words) reproduces successive ranks, and actual check.py examined; this is corroboration of induction, not infinite proof. Need exact LSB order and cyclic wrap.
residual_risks: Ordering dependent and not invariant under arbitrary coordinate permutations; finite m<=5 checks do not replace all-m induction.
